_note: What you see: The first set-up, sample data step: each sample set as a card with a description and counts, several sets can load at once, and the groups the set-up creates in plain words.

Welkom bij decidiq, Gemeente Zuiddrecht: Welcome to decidiq, Municipality of Zuiddrecht
Rond de eerste inrichting af of maak zel: Finish the first set-up or create a governing body yourself.
Kies een of meer voorbeeldsets om decidi: Choose one or more sample sets to get to know decidiq. Each set loads its own governing bodies, meetings, decisions and templates.
Gemeenteraad, college, drie commissies e: Municipal council, executive, three committees and a group, with half a year of meetings and decisions.
Algemene ledenvergadering, bestuur en ka: General members' meeting, board and audit committee.
Raad van bestuur en raad van commissaris: Board of directors and supervisory board.
Ondernemingsraad met adviesaanvragen en: Works council with advice requests and consent requests.
Begin met een lege omgeving. Kies dit vo: Start with an empty environment. Choose this for production use.
